name: Biwaichi
why: the classic weekend loop from Kyoto: 190 km of lakeside on quiet roads and paths, with a castle town and hot springs on the way
note: National cycle route round Lake Biwa, Japan's largest lake · anticlockwise: the north tip, Nagahama, Hikone castle, Ōtsu, then the west shore back · flat, the blue line all the way
